policy_context.execution_authorization_reference: Owner instruction in active conversation: run this diagnostic once; no retry or resource-only rehearsal.
policy_context.resource_basis: One serial API-level latency diagnostic: scalar counts 0–6 x HNSW/FLAT x three repetitions; each case creates, closes, reopens, closes one empty collection; 84 API opens total; no documents or queries; schema construction, close, shutdown and cleanup excluded from per-API timers.
policy_context.risk_acceptance_reference: Retain operation-approved 3 GiB MemAvailable / 8 GiB free-disk reserves, 1 GiB MemoryMax, swap 0, CPU 200%, tasks 128, 20 s workload timeout, correctness, safety telemetry and verified cleanup; host load and positive swap/reclaim deltas are observations; workspace capacity may remain UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE.

postflight_workspace.limitations: No atomic snapshot/quota backend. A traversal can miss creates/growth/mmap/replacements between observations; no upper bound or verified lifetime peak. One pass, no retry. Deadline is cooperative, not a bound on one blocked kernel syscall.
postflight_workspace.mutation_observer: bounded per-pass inotify; not independent capacity proof; mmap/writeback not covered

postflight_workspace_capacity.proof_semantics: owner-approved monitored soft budgets only; NOT hard enforcement/capacity proof
